# Project-merge + wizard + invitation plan

**Status:** temp planning doc. Delete after implementation lands.

## Vision (from user, combined)

> Combine project + chat into one flow. Get Started routes to
> project creation. Instead of a static form, use a **chat-driven wizard
> with guided questions** to capture project details. After the brief is
> gathered, the assistant proposes a **crew roster** (how many, per role).
> The contractor selects a crew member for each role slot. When every
> slot is filled, pop a **success modal** simulating an invitation flow
> — "everyone invited, calendars updated."

Read as: **the app is a project-completion wizard, not a search box.**

## End-to-end user flow

```
/ (Home hero + Get Started)
   │
   ▼
/projects (list existing + "Start new project")
   │
   ├─▶ [Start new project]
   │        │
   │        ▼
   │   /projects/:id (workspace — guided wizard)
   │        │
   │        ├──── Phase 1: BRIEF (chat wizard) ─────────────────┐
   │        │     Assistant: "What kind of project?"            │
   │        │     User: "Kitchen remodel in Palm Desert"        │
   │        │     Assistant: "Great — when do you need to       │
   │        │       start? …"  (guided Qs until brief complete) │
   │        │                                                    │
   │        ├──── Phase 2: ROSTER (assistant proposal) ─────────┤
   │        │     Assistant: "Based on that, you'll need:       │
   │        │       1 electrician, 1 plumber, 1 tile setter,    │
   │        │       1 painter. Here are candidates for each."   │
   │        │     (Renders SubcontractorResults per role slot)  │
   │        │                                                    │
   │        ├──── Phase 3: SELECTION ───────────────────────────┤
   │        │     Contractor taps "Select" on one card per      │
   │        │     role. Progress bar: "2 of 4 crew selected."   │
   │        │     Sidebar rail shows selected crew persistently. │
   │        │     User may chat to swap ("actually find me      │
   │        │     a different tile setter") — assistant does    │
   │        │     a fresh search_subcontractors call.           │
   │        │                                                    │
   │        └──── Phase 4: INVITE ──────────────────────────────┘
   │              When all slots filled, "Send invitations"
   │              button appears. Click → modal:
   │              "✓ 4 crew invited. Calendars updated."
   │              Project.status flips to "invited".
   │
   └─▶ [Resume existing project] → same workspace, jumps to whichever phase it's in
```

## Route map

| Now | Proposed | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | `/` | Get Started CTA → `/projects` |
| `/chat` | *(302 to `/projects`)* | Deleted; workspace is the chat |
| `/team` | `/team` | Unchanged — roster browse |
| `/projects` | `/projects` | Real list, not placeholder |
| — | `/projects/:id` | Wizard workspace (all four phases) |
| `/account` | `/account` | Unchanged |

**Not adding `/projects/new`** — creating a project happens with one
click from `/projects`; the wizard starts immediately with the
assistant's opening question.

## Data model — `projects` collection

```js
{
  _id: ObjectId,
  name: string,                             // auto-suggested from first Q; user-editable
  brief: {
    where:    { city: string, state: "CA" } | null,
    when:     "today" | "tomorrow" | "this-week" | "this-month" | "flexible" | null,
    what:     string | null,                // free-text project description
    budget:   string | null,                // "under-1k" | "1-5k" | "5-25k" | "25k+" | null
    complete: boolean,                      // set true once assistant proposes roster
  },
  crewRoster: [
    {
      role:    string,                      // canonical role key
      count:   number,                      // usually 1, but "2 electricians" possible
```

content.description: Rename crew → subcontractors. Replace flat skills[] with specializations: [{ skill, level 1-5, yearsInSpecialty }]. Update SearchLog. content.subject: Build /api/search + /api/chat (tool calling)
content.description: /api/search: brief-required endpoint, takes {description}, returns ranked matches + rationale + parsedFilters + latencyMs. /api/chat: takes {messages[]}, invokes Groq with function-calling schema for search_subcontractors tool, executes tool server-side, returns assistant message + tool results for client to render as rich components. Both share the same underlying ranker.

content.subject: Populate .env (GROQ_API_KEY + MONGODB_URI)
content.description: User will fill .env with MONGODB_URI (Atlas connection string) and GROQ_API_KEY. GROQ_BASE_URL and GROQ_MODEL have sensible defaults in code. Scaffold provides .env.example as template.

content.subject: Smoke-test Groq + local Mongo connectivity
content.description: Node script: (a) POST to Groq chat.completions using openai/gpt-oss-120b, (b) connect to local mongod at mongodb://localhost:27017/matchmaker and list dbs.

content.subject: Scaffold repo (server + client + shared)
content.description: Create /server (Express + Mongoose + OpenAI SDK), /client (Vite + React), /shared (role dictionary + US city coords), root package.json with dev scripts, .gitignore.

content.subject: Build Subcontractor model (with specializations) + seed 10k
content.description: Rename crew → subcontractors. Replace flat skills[] with specializations: [{ skill, level 1-5, yearsInSpecialty }]. Update SearchLog. Update seed script: generates 3-6 specializations per person from SKILL_POOL_BY_ROLE with realistic level distribution (mostly 2-4, few 5s). Includes gender + headshotUrl (deterministic from headshot pool manifest). 2dsphere index, Atlas Search index.

content.subject: Build /api/search + /api/chat (tool calling)
content.description: /api/search: brief-required endpoint, takes {description}, returns ranked matches + rationale + parsedFilters + latencyMs. /api/chat: takes {messages[]}, invokes Groq with function-calling schema for search_subcontractors tool, executes tool server-side, returns assistant message + tool results for client to render as rich components. Both share the same underlying ranker.

content.subject: Build SPA (Home hero + Chat + Team + Projects + Account) with sidebar + SSR shell
content.description: Server-rendered shell (Express serves index.html with sidebar layout) + React SPA hydration. Routes: / (hero + Get started), /chat (fullscreen chat with tool-rendered SubcontractorCards, Framer stagger reveal), /team (roster browse), /projects (saved sessions), /account (static contractor). Sidebar: Home, Chat, Team, Projects, Account. Uses user-provided Tailwind UI paste-in components.

content.subject: Polish, demo dry-run, prep out-of-scope answers
content.description: Error states, empty-result handling, README with demo instructions, rehearse 5-min demo, prep talking points for auth/analytics/cost/date-time/vector-search follow-ups.

content.subject: Write full architecture docs in /docs/architecture
content.description: Full architectural plan for the app broken into topic files: overview, data-model, search-flow, llm-integration, seeding, api, frontend, future-work. Reference document that AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md point to.

content.subject: Write AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md pointing to /docs/architecture
content.description: AGENTS.md at repo root as the canonical agent-context file (stack, workflow, conventions, pointers to /docs/architecture). CLAUDE.md as a thin pointer to AGENTS.md so Claude Code loads it on session start.

content.subject: Wire up Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui in client
content.description: Install tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, clsx, class-variance-authority, tailwind-merge, tailwindcss-animate, lucide-react, @radix-ui/react-slot. Create tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, lib/utils.js (cn helper), components.json (shadcn), replace index.css with Tailwind directives + shadcn CSS vars.

content.subject: Generate headshot pool via Gemini (Imagen 3)
content.description: Node script (server/scripts/generate-headshots.js) using @google/genai to generate ~40 diverse construction-worker headshots via Imagen 3 (or Gemini 2.5 Flash Image as fallback). Saved to client/public/headshots/. Crew model gains headshotUrl; seed assigns from pool deterministically by hash of _id + role/gender.

content.subject: Update architecture docs for Subcontractor + specializations + chat + SoCal
content.description: Rewrite data-model.md (Subcontractor + specializations schema), seeding.md (SoCal cities, specialization generation), api.md (add /api/chat), frontend.md (mobile-first chat), search-flow.md (ranking includes specialization level), llm-integration.md (tool calling section), AGENTS.md pointer updates.

content.subject: Generate UI mockup / vibe reference images via Gemini

content.subject: Populate .env (GROQ_API_KEY + MONGODB_URI)
content.description: User will fill .env with MONGODB_URI (Atlas connection string) and GROQ_API_KEY. GROQ_BASE_URL and GROQ_MODEL have sensible defaults in code. Scaffold provides .env.example as template.

content.subject: Smoke-test Groq + local Mongo connectivity
content.description: Node script: (a) POST to Groq chat.completions using openai/gpt-oss-120b, (b) connect to local mongod at mongodb://localhost:27017/matchmaker and list dbs.

content.subject: Scaffold repo (server + client + shared)
content.description: Create /server (Express + Mongoose + OpenAI SDK), /client (Vite + React), /shared (role dictionary + US city coords), root package.json with dev scripts, .gitignore.

content.subject: Build Subcontractor model (with specializations) + seed 10k
content.description: Rename crew → subcontractors. Replace flat skills[] with specializations: [{ skill, level 1-5, yearsInSpecialty }]. Update SearchLog. Update seed script: generates 3-6 specializations per person from SKILL_POOL_BY_ROLE with realistic level distribution (mostly 2-4, few 5s). Includes gender + headshotUrl (deterministic from headshot pool manifest). 2dsphere index, Atlas Search index.

content.subject: Build /api/search + /api/chat (tool calling)
content.description: /api/search: brief-required endpoint, takes {description}, returns ranked matches + rationale + parsedFilters + latencyMs. /api/chat: takes {messages[]}, invokes Groq with function-calling schema for search_subcontractors tool, executes tool server-side, returns assistant message + tool results for client to render as rich components. Both share the same underlying ranker.

content.subject: Build SPA (Home hero + Chat + Team + Projects + Account) with sidebar + SSR shell
content.description: Server-rendered shell (Express serves index.html with sidebar layout) + React SPA hydration. Routes: / (hero + Get started), /chat (fullscreen chat with tool-rendered SubcontractorCards, Framer stagger reveal), /team (roster browse), /projects (saved sessions), /account (static contractor). Sidebar: Home, Chat, Team, Projects, Account. Uses user-provided Tailwind UI paste-in components.

content.subject: Polish, demo dry-run, prep out-of-scope answers
content.description: Error states, empty-result handling, README with demo instructions, rehearse 5-min demo, prep talking points for auth/analytics/cost/date-time/vector-search follow-ups.

content.subject: Write full architecture docs in /docs/architecture
content.description: Full architectural plan for the app broken into topic files: overview, data-model, search-flow, llm-integration, seeding, api, frontend, future-work. Reference document that AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md point to.

content.subject: Write AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md pointing to /docs/architecture
content.description: AGENTS.md at repo root as the canonical agent-context file (stack, workflow, conventions, pointers to /docs/architecture). CLAUDE.md as a thin pointer to AGENTS.md so Claude Code loads it on session start.

content.subject: Wire up Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui in client
content.description: Install tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, clsx, class-variance-authority, tailwind-merge, tailwindcss-animate, lucide-react, @radix-ui/react-slot. Create tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, lib/utils.js (cn helper), components.json (shadcn), replace index.css with Tailwind directives + shadcn CSS vars.

content.subject: Generate headshot pool via Gemini (Imagen 3)
content.description: Node script (server/scripts/generate-headshots.js) using @google/genai to generate ~40 diverse construction-worker headshots via Imagen 3 (or Gemini 2.5 Flash Image as fallback). Saved to client/public/headshots/. Crew model gains headshotUrl; seed assigns from pool deterministically by hash of _id + role/gender.

content.subject: Update architecture docs for Subcontractor + specializations + chat + SoCal
content.description: Rewrite data-model.md (Subcontractor + specializations schema), seeding.md (SoCal cities, specialization generation), api.md (add /api/chat), frontend.md (mobile-first chat), search-flow.md (ranking includes specialization level), llm-integration.md (tool calling section), AGENTS.md pointer updates.

content.subject: Generate UI mockup / vibe reference images via Gemini
content.description: Write server/scripts/generate-mockups.js — uses same Imagen 3 / Gemini 2.5 Flash Image path as headshots, but with prompts targeting UI mockups of the finished app + construction-themed hero imagery. Saves to docs/architecture/ui-references/mockups/. Meant for visual direction reference, not for use in the built app.

content.subject: Rebrand to "Kristel Match" — hero, sidebar, account, favicon, logo
content.description: User request: rename app to Kristel Match (inspired by William Krisel, Palm Springs mid-century architect known for butterfly roofs). Full-viewport hero with faded Kristel background photo, sidebar name change, Joseph Sardella on Account page, Gemini-generated butterfly-roof-themed logo + favicon.

content.subject: Sidebar: translucent + collapsible + thinner font weights everywhere
content.description: Sidebar gets bg-card/75 + backdrop-blur (see-through), plus a collapse toggle that shrinks it to icon-only rail. Font weights everywhere dropped one notch: headings 500→400, nav/brand/button 500→400.

content.subject: Project-merge: workspace wizard + crew roster + invitation flow
content.description: Per project-merge.md: absorb /chat into project workspace. New Project Mongo model with brief + crewRoster + invitations + status. content.subject: Team page: Zillow-style search + Recommended section
content.description: Rebuild Team with a sticky top filter bar (search input, role/county/availability filters, live count) and a "Recommended for you" section above the main grid showing top-rated available crew.

Fair — I only shipped server code and never restarted the client to show anything visible. Nothing for you to see yet. My bad.

Restating the flow so we're aligned:

1. **`/projects`** — one page. Shows **"Create new project"** button + list of any existing projects (empty on first visit).
2. Click **Create new project** → routes to the project workspace at `/projects/:id`.
3. **Workspace opens directly into a chat wizard** — assistant asks guided questions to capture brief (what / where / when).
4. Once assistant has enough, it **proposes a crew roster** (e.g. "you'll need 1 electrician + 1 plumber + 1 tile setter") + **auto-runs a search for each role**, rendering candidates inline.
5. User taps **Select** on the cards they like. Rail on the side shows filled/empty slots + progress bar.
6. User can keep chatting to **refine** ("actually find me one with EV charger experience") — assistant re-searches for that slot.
7. When **all slots filled**, a **Send invitations** CTA appears → click → **modal**: "✓ 4 crew invited. Calendars updated." → back to `/projects`.
8. `/projects` list now shows that completed project alongside the Create button.

**No `/chat` route anywhere.** Deleted entirely, deleted from sidebar.

Speak up if you'd rather it all lived at `/projects`.

**Otherwise no questions — executing now.** Client work: ProjectsList → ProjectWorkspace → CrewRosterRail → SelectableSubcontractorCard → InvitationModal → wire routes → kill `/chat` → home CTA → commit + push. Server-side is done; UI is what's left.

content.subject: Build Subcontractor model (with specializations) + seed 10k
content.description: Rename crew → subcontractors. Replace flat skills[] with specializations: [{ skill, level 1-5, yearsInSpecialty }]. Update SearchLog. content.subject: Build /api/search + /api/chat (tool calling)

Commit `385e490` on `origin/main`. Vercel is redeploying.

## Try the flow at http://localhost:5173

1. **Sidebar:** Home / **Projects** / Team / Account (Chat gone)
2. **Home → Get Started** → routes to `/projects`
3. **Projects page** — click **"Create new project"** → auto-routes to `/projects/:id`
4. **Workspace:** greeting waiting for you ("Hi! I'm here to help you set up your project…"). Type something like *"kitchen remodel in Palm Desert next week"* — assistant should update the brief chip at the top, ask follow-ups, and eventually propose a crew roster
5. When the assistant proposes the roster, cards will render inline with **"Select for {role}"** buttons
6. Right rail fills in as you select. Progress bar creeps up
7. When every slot is filled, **"Send invitations"** appears in the rail → click → modal pops with the summary + calendar-updated note
8. **"All projects"** in the modal takes you back to `/projects` where the completed project shows with a green **"Crew invited"** chip

Poke at it, tell me where the reality doesn't match the spec, and I'll iterate.

content.subject: Build Subcontractor model (with specializations) + seed 10k
content.description: Rename crew → subcontractors. Replace flat skills[] with specializations: [{ skill, level 1-5, yearsInSpecialty }]. Update SearchLog. content.subject: Build /api/search + /api/chat (tool calling)
content.description: /api/search: brief-required endpoint, takes {description}, returns ranked matches + rationale + parsedFilters + latencyMs. /api/chat: takes {messages[]}, invokes Groq with function-calling schema for search_subcontractors tool, executes tool server-side, returns assistant message + tool results for client to render as rich components. Both share the same underlying ranker.

content.subject: Populate .env (GROQ_API_KEY + MONGODB_URI)
content.description: User will fill .env with MONGODB_URI (Atlas connection string) and GROQ_API_KEY. GROQ_BASE_URL and GROQ_MODEL have sensible defaults in code. Scaffold provides .env.example as template.

content.subject: Smoke-test Groq + local Mongo connectivity
content.description: Node script: (a) POST to Groq chat.completions using openai/gpt-oss-120b, (b) connect to local mongod at mongodb://localhost:27017/matchmaker and list dbs.

content.subject: Scaffold repo (server + client + shared)
content.description: Create /server (Express + Mongoose + OpenAI SDK), /client (Vite + React), /shared (role dictionary + US city coords), root package.json with dev scripts, .gitignore.

content.subject: Build Subcontractor model (with specializations) + seed 10k
content.description: Rename crew → subcontractors. Replace flat skills[] with specializations: [{ skill, level 1-5, yearsInSpecialty }]. Update SearchLog. Update seed script: generates 3-6 specializations per person from SKILL_POOL_BY_ROLE with realistic level distribution (mostly 2-4, few 5s). Includes gender + headshotUrl (deterministic from headshot pool manifest). 2dsphere index, Atlas Search index.

content.subject: Build /api/search + /api/chat (tool calling)
content.description: /api/search: brief-required endpoint, takes {description}, returns ranked matches + rationale + parsedFilters + latencyMs. /api/chat: takes {messages[]}, invokes Groq with function-calling schema for search_subcontractors tool, executes tool server-side, returns assistant message + tool results for client to render as rich components. Both share the same underlying ranker.

content.subject: Build SPA (Home hero + Chat + Team + Projects + Account) with sidebar + SSR shell
content.description: Server-rendered shell (Express serves index.html with sidebar layout) + React SPA hydration. Routes: / (hero + Get started), /chat (fullscreen chat with tool-rendered SubcontractorCards, Framer stagger reveal), /team (roster browse), /projects (saved sessions), /account (static contractor). Sidebar: Home, Chat, Team, Projects, Account. Uses user-provided Tailwind UI paste-in components.

content.subject: Polish, demo dry-run, prep out-of-scope answers
content.description: Error states, empty-result handling, README with demo instructions, rehearse 5-min demo, prep talking points for auth/analytics/cost/date-time/vector-search follow-ups.

content.subject: Write full architecture docs in /docs/architecture
content.description: Full architectural plan for the app broken into topic files: overview, data-model, search-flow, llm-integration, seeding, api, frontend, future-work. Reference document that AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md point to.

content.subject: Write AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md pointing to /docs/architecture
content.description: AGENTS.md at repo root as the canonical agent-context file (stack, workflow, conventions, pointers to /docs/architecture). CLAUDE.md as a thin pointer to AGENTS.md so Claude Code loads it on session start.

content.subject: Wire up Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui in client
content.description: Install tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, clsx, class-variance-authority, tailwind-merge, tailwindcss-animate, lucide-react, @radix-ui/react-slot. Create tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, lib/utils.js (cn helper), components.json (shadcn), replace index.css with Tailwind directives + shadcn CSS vars.

content.subject: Generate headshot pool via Gemini (Imagen 3)
content.description: Node script (server/scripts/generate-headshots.js) using @google/genai to generate ~40 diverse construction-worker headshots via Imagen 3 (or Gemini 2.5 Flash Image as fallback). Saved to client/public/headshots/. Crew model gains headshotUrl; seed assigns from pool deterministically by hash of _id + role/gender.

content.subject: Update architecture docs for Subcontractor + specializations + chat + SoCal
content.description: Rewrite data-model.md (Subcontractor + specializations schema), seeding.md (SoCal cities, specialization generation), api.md (add /api/chat), frontend.md (mobile-first chat), search-flow.md (ranking includes specialization level), llm-integration.md (tool calling section), AGENTS.md pointer updates.

content.subject: Generate UI mockup / vibe reference images via Gemini
content.description: Write server/scripts/generate-mockups.js — uses same Imagen 3 / Gemini 2.5 Flash Image path as headshots, but with prompts targeting UI mockups of the finished app + construction-themed hero imagery. Saves to docs/architecture/ui-references/mockups/. Meant for visual direction reference, not for use in the built app.

content.subject: Rebrand to "Kristel Match" — hero, sidebar, account, favicon, logo
content.description: User request: rename app to Kristel Match (inspired by William Krisel, Palm Springs mid-century architect known for butterfly roofs). Full-viewport hero with faded Kristel background photo, sidebar name change, Joseph Sardella on Account page, Gemini-generated butterfly-roof-themed logo + favicon.

content.subject: Sidebar: translucent + collapsible + thinner font weights everywhere
content.description: Sidebar gets bg-card/75 + backdrop-blur (see-through), plus a collapse toggle that shrinks it to icon-only rail. Font weights everywhere dropped one notch: headings 500→400, nav/brand/button 500→400.

content.subject: Project-merge: workspace wizard + crew roster + invitation flow
content.description: Per project-merge.md: absorb /chat into project workspace. New Project Mongo model with brief + crewRoster + invitations + status. Chat wizard with three tools (update_project_brief, propose_crew_roster, search_subcontractors). SelectableSubcontractorCard, CrewRosterRail with progress bar, InvitationModal. Delete Chat/Projects pages, wire routes, update docs, delete project-merge.md.

content.subject: Team page: Zillow-style search + Recommended section
content.description: Rebuild Team with a sticky top filter bar (search input, role/county/availability filters, live count) and a "Recommended for you" section above the main grid showing top-rated available crew.

content.subject: Populate .env (GROQ_API_KEY + MONGODB_URI)
content.description: User will fill .env with MONGODB_URI (Atlas connection string) and GROQ_API_KEY. GROQ_BASE_URL and GROQ_MODEL have sensible defaults in code. Scaffold provides .env.example as template.

content.subject: Smoke-test Groq + local Mongo connectivity
content.description: Node script: (a) POST to Groq chat.completions using openai/gpt-oss-120b, (b) connect to local mongod at mongodb://localhost:27017/matchmaker and list dbs.

content.subject: Scaffold repo (server + client + shared)
content.description: Create /server (Express + Mongoose + OpenAI SDK), /client (Vite + React), /shared (role dictionary + US city coords), root package.json with dev scripts, .gitignore.

content.subject: Build Subcontractor model (with specializations) + seed 10k
content.description: Rename crew → subcontractors. Replace flat skills[] with specializations: [{ skill, level 1-5, yearsInSpecialty }]. Update SearchLog. Update seed script: generates 3-6 specializations per person from SKILL_POOL_BY_ROLE with realistic level distribution (mostly 2-4, few 5s). Includes gender + headshotUrl (deterministic from headshot pool manifest). 2dsphere index, Atlas Search index.

content.subject: Build /api/search + /api/chat (tool calling)
content.description: /api/search: brief-required endpoint, takes {description}, returns ranked matches + rationale + parsedFilters + latencyMs. /api/chat: takes {messages[]}, invokes Groq with function-calling schema for search_subcontractors tool, executes tool server-side, returns assistant message + tool results for client to render as rich components. Both share the same underlying ranker.

content.subject: Build SPA (Home hero + Chat + Team + Projects + Account) with sidebar + SSR shell
content.description: Server-rendered shell (Express serves index.html with sidebar layout) + React SPA hydration. Routes: / (hero + Get started), /chat (fullscreen chat with tool-rendered SubcontractorCards, Framer stagger reveal), /team (roster browse), /projects (saved sessions), /account (static contractor). Sidebar: Home, Chat, Team, Projects, Account. Uses user-provided Tailwind UI paste-in components.

content.subject: Polish, demo dry-run, prep out-of-scope answers
content.description: Error states, empty-result handling, README with demo instructions, rehearse 5-min demo, prep talking points for auth/analytics/cost/date-time/vector-search follow-ups.

content.subject: Write full architecture docs in /docs/architecture
content.description: Full architectural plan for the app broken into topic files: overview, data-model, search-flow, llm-integration, seeding, api, frontend, future-work. Reference document that AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md point to.

content.subject: Write AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md pointing to /docs/architecture
content.description: AGENTS.md at repo root as the canonical agent-context file (stack, workflow, conventions, pointers to /docs/architecture). CLAUDE.md as a thin pointer to AGENTS.md so Claude Code loads it on session start.

content.subject: Wire up Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui in client
content.description: Install tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, clsx, class-variance-authority, tailwind-merge, tailwindcss-animate, lucide-react, @radix-ui/react-slot. Create tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js, lib/utils.js (cn helper), components.json (shadcn), replace index.css with Tailwind directives + shadcn CSS vars.

content.subject: Generate headshot pool via Gemini (Imagen 3)
content.description: Node script (server/scripts/generate-headshots.js) using @google/genai to generate ~40 diverse construction-worker headshots via Imagen 3 (or Gemini 2.5 Flash Image as fallback). Saved to client/public/headshots/. Crew model gains headshotUrl; seed assigns from pool deterministically by hash of _id + role/gender.

content.subject: Update architecture docs for Subcontractor + specializations + chat + SoCal
content.description: Rewrite data-model.md (Subcontractor + specializations schema), seeding.md (SoCal cities, specialization generation), api.md (add /api/chat), frontend.md (mobile-first chat), search-flow.md (ranking includes specialization level), llm-integration.md (tool calling section), AGENTS.md pointer updates.

content.subject: Generate UI mockup / vibe reference images via Gemini
content.description: Write server/scripts/generate-mockups.js — uses same Imagen 3 / Gemini 2.5 Flash Image path as headshots, but with prompts targeting UI mockups of the finished app + construction-themed hero imagery. Saves to docs/architecture/ui-references/mockups/. Meant for visual direction reference, not for use in the built app.

content.subject: Rebrand to "Kristel Match" — hero, sidebar, account, favicon, logo
content.description: User request: rename app to Kristel Match (inspired by William Krisel, Palm Springs mid-century architect known for butterfly roofs). Full-viewport hero with faded Kristel background photo, sidebar name change, Joseph Sardella on Account page, Gemini-generated butterfly-roof-themed logo + favicon.

content.subject: Sidebar: translucent + collapsible + thinner font weights everywhere
content.description: Sidebar gets bg-card/75 + backdrop-blur (see-through), plus a collapse toggle that shrinks it to icon-only rail. Font weights everywhere dropped one notch: headings 500→400, nav/brand/button 500→400.

content.subject: Project-merge: workspace wizard + crew roster + invitation flow
content.description: Per project-merge.md: absorb /chat into project workspace. New Project Mongo model with brief + crewRoster + invitations + status. Chat wizard with three tools (update_project_brief, propose_crew_roster, search_subcontractors). SelectableSubcontractorCard, CrewRosterRail with progress bar, InvitationModal. Delete Chat/Projects pages, wire routes, update docs, delete project-merge.md.

content.subject: Team page: Zillow-style search + Recommended section
content.description: Rebuild Team with a sticky top filter bar (search input, role/county/availability filters, live count) and a "Recommended for you" section above the main grid showing top-rated available crew.

content.subject: Move MongoDB from local to MongoDB Atlas (live)
content.description: Migrate from local mongod to hosted Atlas so the deployed Vercel app can hit the DB. Steps: create Atlas cluster + user + IP allowlist, seed against Atlas, swap MONGODB_URI in .env.local, add MONGODB_URI to Vercel project env vars, verify /api/subcontractors returns from Atlas.
